The brown door slab visibly fills the rightmost 45 percent of this left vignette. Zuv stands entirely to its left in an unmistakable RIGHT-FACING side profile: nose, gaze, chest, pelvis, knees, and toes all point right toward the door, never left toward Aachu. His door-facing arm extends only to the right and his anatomical LEFT hand grips the single lever visibly mounted on the brown slab just inside its left edge.
